name: Bala Brahmeswara Temple
location: Adjacent to Jogulamba Temple / Historic Nava Brahma Temple complex
significance: Head shrine of the Nava Brahma group where the idol of Goddess Jogulamba along with the idols of Chandi and Mundi was protected and kept until 2005.

name: Nava Brahma Temples
significance: Group of nine 7th-century Shiva shrines built during Badami Chalukya rule featuring rock-cut Nagara architecture.

name: Idols of Chandi and Mundi
significance: Protected alongside Goddess Jogulamba during the Bahmani invasions and reinstalled.
